name: Valley of Fangs
summary: In the Badlands, a small camp keeps to the Valley of Fangs while predators roam nearby.

sections.title: A Treacherous Pass
sections.body:
The Valley of Fangs runs between two great stone formations in the heart of the Badlands. Feral crag coyotes, prowling cougars, and vicious wolves stalk its dusty floor, so lone travelers face danger in the pass.

A handful of wayward figures camp there. Martek the Exiled, a banished orc, keeps company with the goblins Rigglefuzz and Jazzrik. Far from the regional outposts, they tinker in seclusion.

faq.q: Where is the Valley of Fangs located?
faq.answer: The Valley of Fangs lies in the central Badlands, between two massive natural rock formations south of the main northern ridgeline.

faq.q: Who lives in the Valley of Fangs?
aliases: who is in valley of fangs
faq.answer: Martek the Exiled, a lone orc, and his goblin companions Rigglefuzz and Jazzrik live at a small wayside camp.

faq.q: Why is the valley dangerous to travel through?
aliases: what attacks you in valley of fangs
faq.answer: Cougars, wolves, and coyotes roam the valley floor and ambush wanderers in its narrow terrain.

faq.q: Why did Martek and the goblins set up here?
aliases: why camp in valley of fangs
faq.answer: Cast out and wandering the wastes, Martek the Exiled found a quiet, defensible niche between the rock walls. His goblin companions are willing to trade and tinker away from the prying eyes of major factions.

angles.text: As an engineer, you may find goblin tinkerers at the Valley of Fangs camp, working far from the arid wastes' outposts.
As a hunter, you can track cougars and wolves through the valley and tame rugged Badlands beasts.
